biological_mechanism.gene_mutation: PINK1 mutant rescued by Parkin Overexpression (pink1[B9]; UAS-parkin / 25-day-old)
biological_mechanism.cellular_pathology: Transgenic overexpression of Parkin acts downstream of PINK1 to clear damaged mitochondria (mitophagy), suppressing dopaminergic neuron apoptosis and restoring locomotor capability near wild-type levels
biological_mechanism.lif_intervention: Computational restoration of 85-90% of dopaminergic synaptic inputs in the descending pathway, rescuing forward drive and inter-leg coordination
biological_mechanism.primary_citation: Yang et al., 2006 (PNAS, DOI: 10.1073/pnas.0602493103); Park et al., 2006 (Nature, DOI: 10.1038/nature04623)

provenance.simulation_engine: LIF neural network simulation on Google Colab
